clips.caption:
Most people say it's harder than ever to make money. Kevin Trudeau says the opposite is true - it's easier today than at any point in history.

You don't need inventory. You don't need a storefront. You don't need to raise capital. The access that used to cost thousands and take years is sitting free on YouTube right now.

So when someone says 'I don't know how to do that,' Kevin's answer is simple: spend five minutes and go find out. 'That'll take three hours' is just another excuse wearing a watch.

A failure is always good at one thing - making excuses.

What's the thing you've been telling yourself you don't know how to do?

#kevintrudeau #moneymindset #entrepreneur #makemoney #successhabits #hustle

Kevin Trudeau was at a yacht show with a friend who was clearly shopping seriously - asking about the wood, the build, every detail on a $25 million boat.

Kevin finally asked: you're doing this well? His friend laughed - 'I can't afford this. I don't have the money.' So why are you here? 'I'm dreaming about my future. If I don't dream about it, I'll never make the money.'

Most people do it backwards - wait for the money before they let themselves want anything. And they'll wait forever, because the money never comes first.

The dream has to get bigger before the money does.

What have you stopped letting yourself want because you can't afford it yet?
